# Cyber Kings (2026-11-17): Hegemonic Ambitions. GENERATED by _dev/scripts/hegemonies/gen_ambitions.py - change the generator, not this file.

# Any declared ambition (one at a time)
ck_has_hegemonic_ambition = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_any }

# Cooldown after a failed or abandoned ambition
ck_ambition_on_cooldown = {
	OR = {
		has_character_modifier = ck_ambition_thwarted_modifier
		has_character_modifier = ck_ambition_abandoned_modifier
	}
}

# Basic standing: an independent king or greater
ck_ambition_standing = {
	is_ruler = yes
	is_landed = yes
	is_independent_ruler = yes
	highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
}

# Holds a mid-level hegemony or Sol (lower-level ambitions are behind such a ruler)
ck_ambition_holds_mid_or_sol = {
	OR = {
		has_title = title:h_ck_terra
		has_title = title:h_ck_helian
		has_title = title:h_ck_celestial
		has_title = title:h_ck_sol
	}
}

# Terra (mid level): may this character hold this ambition at all (land threshold aside)?
ck_ambition_possible_terra = {
	ck_ambition_standing = yes
	ck_ambition_holds_mid_or_sol = no
	NOT = { exists = title:h_ck_terra.holder }
}
# ... and is close enough to declare it now (no other ambition, no cooldown)
ck_ambition_can_declare_terra = {
	ck_ambition_possible_terra = yes
	ck_has_hegemonic_ambition = no
	ck_ambition_on_cooldown = no
	ck_ambition_progress_terra >= ck_ambition_needed_terra
}
# County scope: is this county part of what the ambition covers?
ck_ambition_county_in_terra = {
	title_province = { geographical_region = ckworld_earth }
}

# Holds a lower-level (world) hegemony whose capital lies in this group, e.g. h_venus or h_mars for Helian,
# h_moon or h_galilean for Celestial - including one won by a world struggle's Concord (DLC_ADAPTATION §17).
ck_ambition_holds_world_hegemony_terra = {
	any_held_title = {
		tier = tier_hegemony
		NOR = {
			this = title:h_ck_terra
			this = title:h_ck_helian
			this = title:h_ck_celestial
			this = title:h_ck_sol
		}
		title_capital_county ?= { title_province = { geographical_region = ckworld_earth } }
	}
}
